Danu secures funding for recycling robotics

TechCrunch reports Danu raised $5 million.

TechCrunch / Danu Robotics ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

The developer’s product approach

Danu describes two-arm robots for mixed recyclables that retrofit existing lines. It claims less than one metre of conveyor space, plus guards when operating near workers.

Counting completed picks

According to Danu’s product information, vision outlines target objects and a pick is counted when material reaches the bin, distinguishing grasping from completed sorting.

Hardware and software

Danu separates hardware purchase from software licensing and claims gripper replacement in 20 minutes. These are existing company product descriptions, not independent tests or newly launched specifications.
